title.en: An Act to Amend Act Numbered thirty-Four Hundred and Twenty-Two Which Confers Upon Municipal Councils General Authority to Levy Taxes Subject to Certain Limitations.

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and twenty-two, is hereby amended by
adding thereto the following proviso:
"And provided, further, That hawkers, peddlers and hucksters who have secured licenses at the rates fixed by
ordinance in any municipality shall not be required to take out licenses in any other municipality through
which they may travel for business for a period not exceeding twenty-seven days during each quarter, unless
the term for the renewal of such licenses shall have expired."

This Act shall take effect on January first nineteen hundred and thirty-one.
Approved, November 20, 1930.
